summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its planned acquisition of Halo Privacy and havenX through a merger agreement signed May 7, 2026, is unlikely to close by the July 31, 2026 outside date. A key employee declined to commence employment, a material condition cannot be satisfied, and Halo/havenX failed to deliver audited financials and estimated closing consideration. Termination is possible, with no terms or premiums specified. Watch for formal termination or renegotiation.
